tower_transcript: The tower’s original words are unavailable, so a human must check the instruction.
addressed: The tower’s call may be for a different plane, so a human must check the recipient.
fresh: The tower’s instruction may be out of date, so a human must check it still applies.
restrictive: This is not a verified stop/wait instruction and could let the plane move, so a human must decide.
confidence: The agents are not confident enough that these are the right words, so a human must check them.
hint_agrees: The plane’s memory disagrees with the recovered instruction, so a human must resolve the difference.
autonomy_on: Auto-resend is switched off, so a human must decide whether to send this instruction.
